reason: My Fresha page and Instagram already get me bookings, so I don't feel I need a website right now. Even with nothing to pay upfront, I'm not handing my business to a bloke in Kuwait with no UK reviews when people in my Facebook group recommend local folk.
objection: No reviews and no past clients I can actually ring up. The one real job is anonymous and in Kuwait, and the rest are made-up demos. If something breaks I'm chasing someone on WhatsApp in another time zone.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of real Manchester businesses, ideally salons, I can look up and message, or someone in my local Facebook group vouching for him.
